summary: Implementation plan for the Unified 35-42 Question Clinical Assessment Package across all 5 Life-Stage Cohorts, including 30+ common foundational clinical questions (Anthropometrics, Dietary History, Female Cycle Sync / Shakti when female, Ayurvedic Vikriti, Microbiome & Digestion, Functional Metabolism, Inflammation, Mind, and Medical/Medication History), 8-10 condition-specific questions per cohort/disease, and a dedicated 32-question Pediatric package for children.
